address: Berlage Lyceum, Pieter Lodewijk Takstraat 33, Amsterdam (1924 Amsterdam School school in yellow brick)
notes: Berlage Lyceum, Pieter Lodewijk Takstraat 33 (pand 0363100012127997, 1924, 107 LoD2.2 surfaces, roof max 20.1 m). Photographed: the south front (2019-05-08 w03-167 and 2025-09-29 w02-167, surfaces 70/72/40/103 and the central entrance panel 35/101: pale yellow brick, three storeys, three window groups per storey, each a wide multi-light window with a side light either side set in a stone surround, a dentil cornice under a flat roof, a railing at the foot) and the 37 m east front (2025-09-29 w01-77, surfaces 21/69: a wide window band at ground, two rows of grouped windows above, small square lights at the ends).

MODELLED: three yellow-brick storeys, the south bays on the 8.6 m rhythm with a multi-light window each (new `wide` preset: four lights and a transom), stone piers, the entrance with a stone portal, the east front as seven wide windows per storey. SIMPLIFIED: the side lights and recessed stone surrounds of each group are one window; the east front's ground band, upper groups and small square lights are regularised to seven equal bays; cornice dentils are not drawn. SKIPPED: the area railing (too thin), awnings and sun blinds (temporary), the north, west and courtyard walls (no panorama within range: blank), the carved relief at the south-east corner (not resolvable).
